rationale: PROGRESS_CUT + PROBE_SCALE combined (2026-07-17): the two are complementary - probe reduces cost of the ~coin-flip cohort by sizing them small, progress_cut ends them early instead of holding to the 6h time limit. Testing together at default params, plus one variant tuned toward the more aggressive end of each individual sweep.
